observations.finding: 30 of 50 HALLMARK pathways significant at q<0.05; strongest effects include HALLMARK_ALLOGRAFT_REJECTION up (SMD +1.056, q=0.0), HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING up (SMD +0.920, q=3.3e-05), HALLMARK_DNA_REPAIR up (SMD +0.872, q=0.0003), and HALLMARK_HEME_METABOLISM down (SMD -1.083, q=0.0).

No WXS feature reaches q<0.05 (min q=0.0545). BAP1 is enriched (21.8% vs 2.1%, OR 13.1, 95% CI 1.64-105.2, p=0.0025, q=0.055); PBRM1 is depleted (27.3% vs 50.0%, OR 0.375, q=0.159); ATM absent in set (0% vs 12.5%, q=0.094).

biological_support.statistical_interpretation: Strong, coherent RNA pathway signal with large standardized effects and multiple q<0.05 findings. WXS shows a consistent direction (BAP1 enrichment, PBRM1 depletion) but no feature survives FDR; the BAP1 association is borderline (q=0.055) with a wide confidence interval.
biological_support.medical_interpretation: C0001 shows a distinct transcriptional program (immune/inflammatory and DNA-repair up, heme metabolism down) with a mutation profile trending toward BAP1 enrichment and PBRM1 depletion, consistent with a biologically differentiated group. No prognostic or clinical claims are made.
limitations: WXS findings do not survive multiple-testing correction.
BAP1 odds ratio CI is very wide (1.6-105).
Pathway scores are relative to the rest of the partition.

cross_modal_consistency.statistical_interpretation: Membership is supported by multiple modalities with modest positive silhouettes, strongest for RNA and WXS. cross_modal_consistency.medical_interpretation: C0001 forms a structurally coherent group whose membership is corroborated across modalities, with RNA and WXS providing the strongest support; boundaries are weak but directionally consistent.
limitations: Silhouette magnitudes are small.
Resampling reused the existing SNF affinity subgraph; affinities were not re-estimated.
Structural diagnostics describe the partition and do not independently validate subtype identity.

observations.finding: No notable technical association flagged; set_significant_fields_by_set for C0001 is empty; categorical_warning_association and numeric_significant_association both false.
Global tissue_source_site association q=0.088 (Cramer's V=0.309); C0001 BP level q=0.074 (set 29.1% vs rest 60.4%) and CJ level q=0.220 (18.2% vs 2.1%) are not significant after correction.
All CT acquisition fields (phase, manufacturer, scanner model, reconstruction kernel, slice thickness, z-spacing, pixel spacing) have q>0.15 with small effect sizes.

confounder_exclusion.statistical_interpretation: No technical factor reaches significance for C0001. The largest nominal imbalance is tissue source site (BP under-representation, CJ over-representation) but it does not survive correction and is a site/batch descriptor rather than a modality-defining factor.
confounder_exclusion.medical_interpretation: Technical acquisition and site factors do not provide a plausible competing explanation for C0001 membership; the defining RNA/WXS signals are not explained by imaging or site confounders.
limitations: Tissue source site shows a non-significant trend that could reflect residual batch structure.
Only available technical fields were tested.
